question: Do I need to give an entry test for BS?
answer: For the Fall 2026 cycle, the HEC USAT requirement for BS admission is waived, and no credit is given to any entry test score in Self Support BS merit.

question: When will the first merit list be displayed?
answer: The first merit list for the Fall 2026 Self Support BS programmes will be displayed on 5 September 2026. Please check the QAU website regularly as no call letters or phone calls are made.

question: How is merit calculated for BS?
answer: BS merit is calculated using 70% of your FA/FSc Part-I marks and 30% of your SSC (Matric) marks. No entry test score is included.

question: Is there an age limit for admission?
answer: There is no age limit for BS admissions at Quaid-i-Azam University. For further assistance, please contact the admissions office.

question: Can I submit my form by hand at the admission office?
answer: No, applications are accepted only online at qau.edu.pk and not by hand or post.

question: I got 48% in FSc part 1. Can I apply?
answer: No, you need at least 50% marks in FA/FSc Part-I or equivalent for BS admissions. If you need further assistance, please contact the admissions office.

question: I have exactly 50% in FSc part-I, am I eligible for BS Physics?
answer: Yes, you are eligible because BS programmes require at least 50% marks in FA/FSc Part-I (or equivalent) along with the subject eligibility of your chosen programme. There is no age limit for applying.
